question_families.name: State a chemistry definition/term to the memo's separately-ticked elements
question_families.definition: The student must reproduce a definition in the exact elements the marking guidelines reward, not merely a synonym, across any chemistry topic.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Stoichiometric calculation (n=m/M, cV, limiting reagent, % purity/yield)
question_families.definition: A calculation in which the competence is choosing the right stoichiometric relation and substituting consistently with units, then carrying the value through to the answer.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Stoichiometry expressed in words/short-answer and multiple choice
question_families.definition: Stoichiometry items that are not numeric calculations: naming the limiting reagent, stating concentration reasoning, and choosing the correct stoichiometric statement.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Draw a Lewis/Couper diagram of a covalent molecule
question_families.definition: The student must represent a covalent molecule with the correct atoms, shared pairs and lone pairs (Lewis) or bond lines and a dative arrow (Couper).
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Bonding: explain, apply and interpret bonds and structures
question_families.definition: Non-diagram bonding items: explaining bond type, electronegativity, polarity and bond strength, and applying them to properties and structures.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Organic chemistry: naming, functional groups, homologous series and isomers
question_families.definition: The student must apply IUPAC naming, identify functional groups, classify by homologous series and draw/identify structural, positional and chain isomers.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Explain physical properties through intermolecular forces
question_families.definition: Given substances, the student identifies the intermolecular forces present and accounts for a property difference (boiling point, viscosity, solubility) by comparing force strengths.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Reaction-rate explanation via collision theory, Maxwell-Boltzmann and catalysts
question_families.definition: The student explains how a change affects rate via collision theory, interprets or draws a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution and labels activation energy, and states catalyst action.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Energy & Chemical Change: energy-profile interpretation and thermochemistry explanation
question_families.definition: Items that sketch or interpret an energy-profile diagram (reactants, products, EA, dH, activated complex) and explain heat of reaction and the catalyst effect.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Energy & Chemical Change: definitions and applied thermochemistry
question_families.definition: Definitions of enthalpy/heat terms and their applied use in calculating and reasoning about heat change, standard solutions of heat, and related multiple-choice items.
question_families.subject: chemistry

question_families.name: Matter & Materials, Scientific Skills and Atomic Structure
question_families.definition: The residual chemistry-adjacent items: matter classification, scientific-skills graph/table reading and the occasional atomic-structure multiple-choice item.
question_families.subject: chemistry

unresolved_items.summary: Several families rest heavily on diagram- or image-dependent questions whose text layer was readable but whose diagram could not be verified
unresolved_items.detail: Chemistry questions frequently depend on a structure, apparatus or graph image. In this batch the text layer (Rung A) was transcribed, but the diagrams could not be visually verified, so the breakdowns and diagnostics that lean on them are unvalidated. The build appends the per-family image-dependency counts to this item. Families where over half the members are image-dependent (3 of 11): CHEM-004 12/21, CHEM-008 58/100, CHEM-009 24/28.
evidence: chemistry_pass1_evidence modules: requires_visual_verification=True on diagram questions
no data/raw/chemistry/SOURCE_INVENTORY.yaml exists (ORC never ran for chemistry)
unresolved_items.recommended_review: Where a family is majority image-dependent, verify the diagram against the source PDF before using its diagnostics in production; a tutor should not generate a diagnosis from a diagram that was never visually confirmed.

unresolved_items.summary: Chemistry Phase 2 (ORC) was never run, so no SOURCE-* id is available for the Pass 1 records
unresolved_items.detail: The repository has data/raw/physics/SOURCE_INVENTORY.yaml mapping question records to ORC SOURCE-* ids, but no equivalent exists for chemistry and the ORC step was never executed for the chemistry corpus. Per AGENTS.md and SUBJECT_PROMPTS.md, a fake inventory must NOT be invented. Every chemistry Pass 2 object therefore carries the sentinel SOURCE-ORC-CHEM-NOT-INDEXED as its orc_source_id, and this unresolved item records the gap. The referential chain chemistry_{year}_{board}_{ptype}_{period}_q{qn} -> SOURCE-ORC-CHEM-NOT-INDEXED terminates at the sentinel rather than at a real ORC id.
evidence: SUBJECT_PROMPTS.md: do not invent ORC ids or a fake inventory
unresolved_items.recommended_review: Run the Phase 2 ORC acquisition for chemistry and create data/raw/chemistry/SOURCE_INVENTORY.yaml; then map each chemistry_{...}_q{qn} source_id to a real SOURCE-* id and re-point the provenance chain.

unresolved_items.summary: Two marking anomalies were resolved during transcription using the question paper as authoritative
unresolved_items.detail: CHE-2024-NOV: the memo header for Question 5 reads '29 MARKS' but the question paper and the memo marks sum to 13; the memo also prints an incorrect formula for Q6.4.1 (CnH2n+2O2 instead of CnH2nO2). CHE-2025-JUL: the memo header swaps the Question 5 and Question 6 totals; the question paper (Q5=14, Q6=17) is authoritative. All were resolved in favour of the question paper; recorded here so a later reviewer knows the memo was overruled.
evidence: chemistry_pass1_evidence_2024_nov.py header note on Q5/Q6 memo misprints
chemistry_pass1_evidence_2025_july.py header note on Q5/Q6 total swap
unresolved_items.recommended_review: Confirm against a clean copy of the 2024 November and 2025 July memoranda if one becomes available.

unresolved_items.summary: A few questions could only be partially transcribed because the answer depends on an unreadable image
unresolved_items.detail: CHE-2024-NOV Question 6 asks for a flow-diagram completion whose boxes are images, and CHE-2025-NOV Questions 5.4-5.6 ask about displayed organic structures labelled X and Y that are images. The text was transcribed and the items were placed in their families, but the diagram content itself (which bonds, which isomers) could not be confirmed. They are marked requires_visual_verification=True and must not be used to assert a structural claim.
unresolved_items.recommended_review: Recover the source images and transcribe the structures before using these items in a diagnostic.
